QuestInfo.name: Pipopa's Secret Assignment
QuestInfo.0: #p9120014# looks like he wants to ask you something. Go and talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: You have been tasked with identifying the source of the recent chaos in Showa Town. Defeat #o9400100#, #o9400101#, #o9400102#, and #o9400103# from Fire Raccoon Finance at the town entrance and collect the items they drop.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Pipopa the items he requested. He gave you a disguise kit and asked you to use it to infiltrate the Fire Raccoon organization.

0.0: Thank you so much for helping me with my investigation before.
0.1: As you know, Showa Town remains in chaos. The Yakuza who run Fire Raccoon Finance are only increasing in number.
0.2: Do you think you could do me another favor?

yes.0: Excellent. I need someone for an undercover assignment. As you might expect, I can't do it myself. When you're a famous detective like me, everybody knows your face.
yes.1: Step one will be disguising yourself to fit in with the thugs inside the Fire Raccoon Finance building.
yes.2: I want you to beat up #o9400100#, #o9400101#, \n#o9400102#, and #o9400103# thugs prowling around town and bring me anything of theirs that might make for an authentic disguise.

no.0: How can someone with such power refuse to use it? What a waste!

1.0: Did you bring what I asked for?

yes.1: While you were out gathering supplies, I went ahead and purchased something that's sure to help you blend in with the Yakuza. A prosthetic face scar!

item.0: This won't be enough to blend in with the Yakuza.
